source.title: Measurements of Elastic Properties of Biological Hydrogels using Atomic Force Microscopy

formulation.evidence: To prepare agarose gels with 1% (w/v) and 2% (w/v) concentrations, agarose powder weight 1 gram and 2 grams were dissolved in 100 ml de-ionized water

processing.evidence: dissolved in 100 ml de-ionized water and boiled for approximately two minutes in the microwave

youngs_modulus.evidence: The elastic modulus was found to increase from an average value of 168 kPa to 230 kPa (35% increase) when concentration of agarose was increased from 1% to 2%.

notes: Measured at room temperature (25 °C) with DNP-10 AFM tip.
